about: The Boomsday Project's interface (docs/packs/format.md, 'UI theme'): Dr. Boom's laboratory on a floating rock of Netherstorm at night — dark panels of riveted gunmetal with polished copper rims, buttons of deep lab-glass teal that light up neon green under the mouse like a bubbling test tube, cool white text of a blueprint, electric blue for headings like the arc of a Tesla coil, warning red for danger and neon green for confirmations, sparks flying up over the menu; the title in Classic's Cinzel Decorative, in electric blue.
